staff.name: Classroom Teaching Staff (General & SpEd)
staff.title: Certified Classroom Teachers (~920 FTE)
staff.notes: Average teacher salary in Clifton is ~$74,500 based on NJ DOE Taxpayers' Guide. Stepped pay scale negotiated by Clifton Education Association (CEA).

staff.name: Gary S. DeMarzo
staff.title: Interim City Manager
staff.notes: Appointed Interim City Manager following retirement of long-time City Manager Nick Villano in 2025. Directs all city departments, appoints personnel, and prepares municipal budget.

staff.name: Thomas Rinaldi
staff.title: Chief of Police
staff.notes: Leads Clifton Police Department (~150 sworn officers, support personnel, and dispatch). Clifton PD member since 1995.

staff.name: Raymond Grabowski
staff.title: Mayor / Council Member
staff.notes: Elected Mayor & Councilman. Files annual Local Government Ethics Law FDS; operates private investigation business and landscaping company.

staff.name: Mary Sadrakula
staff.title: Councilwoman
staff.notes: City Councilwoman; 40-year career on Wall Street (retired); serves on city Real Estate & Budget committees.

staff.name: Rosemary Pino
staff.title: Councilwoman
staff.notes: City Councilwoman (elected 2018/2022); former BOE trustee (2013-2019); founder of Latino Leaders of Clifton; career in finance/workforce development.

staff.name: Joseph Kolodziej
staff.title: Councilman
staff.notes: City Councilman; Certified Municipal CFO (serves as full-time CFO for Mt. Olive Township); former PVWC commissioner; former BOE trustee.

staff.name: Antonio Latona
staff.title: Councilman
staff.notes: City Councilman; retired Clifton firefighter; US Air Force veteran.

staff.name: Chris D'Amato
staff.title: Councilman
staff.notes: Appointed to Council in 2024 to fill vacancy; community advocate and writer.

staff.name: Clifton Fire Chief
staff.title: Chief of Fire & Emergency Services
staff.notes: Commands ~130 professional career firefighters and EMTs operating from 5 neighborhood fire stations.

staff.name: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
staff.title: Director of Finance / Municipal CFO
staff.notes: Manages municipal treasury, bond issuances, annual financial statement (AFS), and municipal budget.

staff.name: City Clerk
staff.title: Municipal Clerk
staff.notes: Official custodian of municipal records, secretary to City Council, chief election official, and OPRA records officer.

staff.name: Tax Assessor
staff.title: Municipal Tax Assessor
staff.notes: Statutory officer responsible for assessing all commercial, industrial, and residential real estate parcels in Clifton for property taxation.

staff.name: Director of Public Works
staff.title: Director of Public Works (DPW)
staff.notes: Oversees municipal fleet, street repairs, snow plowing, solid waste, and municipal infrastructure.

staff.name: Patrol Officers & Detectives (PBA Local 36)
staff.title: Sworn Police Officers (~140 Officers)
staff.notes: Senior patrol officer base salary reaches ~$144k before longevity, holiday pay, and contractual stipends. Overtime and off-duty private security details are paid separately.

staff.name: Career Firefighters (FMBA Local 21)
staff.title: Professional Firefighters & EMTs (~125 Firefighters)
staff.notes: Top step firefighters earn ~$139k base, excluding overtime, specialty certification pay, and longevity.
